passages.A: None of the three jointly fits the combination this paper's research question asks about: ML-realistic workloads, MCU-class hardware, and energy as a first-class metric, delivered through a reproducible methodology. Closing that gap, rather than extending any one of the three individually, is what the rest of this paper describes; Section 4's reference models, all under 350 kilobytes, illustrate just how far below MLMark's and MLPerf Inference's assumed hardware scale the actual target sits.
passages.B: None of the three jointly fits the combination this paper's research question asks about: ML-realistic workloads, MCU-class hardware, and energy as a first-class metric, delivered through a reproducible methodology.
